1. SCOPE
).1 This standard prescribes the requirements and methods of sampling and test for thiram seed dressing formulations.

2. REQ,UIREMENTS
2.1 Con8tituents -- The materia) shall consist of thirarn, technical, uniformly incorporated ill a suitable inert filler, such as talc and a suitable oil.
2.1.1 Thiram technical employed in the formulation of this material shall conform to IS : 4320-1982�.

2.2 PhY8icai - The material shall comply with the following physical req uirements.

2.2.1 Description - Tile material shall be in tile form of a powder, free from any hard lumps and shall lJe capable of adhering to smooth surfaces.
2.2.2 Colour - The colour of the material shall be subject to an agreement between the purchaser ancl the supplier.

2.2.3 Sieving Requirement -- Not less than 98 percent by mass of the material shall pass through ISO-micron IS Sieve [see IS : 460 ( Part J )1978t ] when te"te<i by the method prescribed in Appendix A.
